edges.reason: Alternatives are only useful if relevant differences can be represented.
Currentness requires a way to let newer evidence override stale unsupported state.
Composition requires stable primitives/distinctions.
Short dependency chains compose multiple primitive operations/states.
Local repair requires knowing which state depends on which support.
A discriminator is defined relative to live alternatives it can separate.
Checks matter through observations that can change qualification.
Transfer requires recognizing consequence-equivalent structure under changed surface.
System dependencies generalize short support chains to interacting paths.
Scoped rollback extends local selective repair to larger dependency cones.
Multi-source synthesis presupposes treating sources/observations as evidence rather than decoration.
Long-horizon currentness extends direct stale/new replacement through dependencies.
Reusable conflict memory requires localizing what failed rather than discarding all state.
Representation inadequacy becomes diagnosable when failures persist across a modeled dependency structure.
Open-world multi-hypothesis maintenance extends small alternative sets across longer histories.
Authority conflict requires multiple evidence channels to remain distinguishable.
Value of more effort depends partly on whether an available check can change a consequential uncertainty.
Expected value of another check is defined relative to unresolved alternatives/decisions.
Refinement is justified when current representation demonstrably loses consequential distinctions.
Sparse long-range maintenance extends consequential history beyond contiguous sequences.
Maintaining multiple hypotheses requires support/dependency structure across candidate states.
Self-directed discrimination acts on a maintained uncertainty structure.
Frontier discriminator selection should allocate inquiry where expected value is high.
Creation generalizes refinement when no current coordinate system is adequate.
Safe compression must preserve enough dependency structure for future selective invalidation.
Compression may merge only states that are consequence-equivalent under expected future discriminators.
Novel decomposition benefits from reusable structural relations without copying surface templates.
Novel problems may require changing the decomposition/representation rather than deeper search in a bad frame.
